name: MaxwellTrack
description: Connect Arduino boards to the MaxwellTrack IoT Cloud over WiFi or cellular (GSM/LTE). Encrypted per-device connection, offline buffering, automatic reconnect, over-the-air updates, datastream telemetry and dashboard commands. Non-WiFi boards connect over a cellular modem.
keywords: iot, cloud, esp32, esp8266, stm32, rp2040, gsm, lte, cellular, ota, maxwelltrack
